# MarkMonitor
> Enterprise brand protection, domain management, and anti-fraud services for global organizations.

MarkMonitor helps organizations manage domain portfolios, protect brands online, and respond to phishing, fraud, and digital threats. Its site includes product overviews, industry solutions, company information, resources, and support access.

## Platform and Services
- [Domain Management](https://www.markmonitor.com/domain-management/): Centralized enterprise domain portfolio management, registration, renewals, and policy control.
- [Brand Protection](https://www.markmonitor.com/brand-protection/): Monitoring and enforcement against online brand abuse, counterfeiting, and infringement.
- [Anti-Fraud](https://www.markmonitor.com/anti-fraud/): Detection and disruption of phishing, impersonation, and other digital fraud threats.
- [Cybersecurity](https://www.markmonitor.com/cybersecurity/): Services focused on reducing external digital risk and protecting online assets.
- [Managed Services](https://www.markmonitor.com/managed-services/): Expert operational support for domain, brand, and threat management programs.
- [Professional Services](https://www.markmonitor.com/professional-services/): Strategic consulting and specialized services for enterprise protection initiatives.

## Solutions by Need
- [Online Brand Protection](https://www.markmonitor.com/solutions/online-brand-protection/): Solutions for identifying and enforcing against misuse of brands across digital channels.
- [Domain Portfolio Management](https://www.markmonitor.com/solutions/domain-portfolio-management/): Tools and services for governing complex global domain portfolios.
- [Phishing and Impersonation](https://www.markmonitor.com/solutions/phishing-and-impersonation/): Detection and takedown support for phishing sites and impersonation campaigns.
- [Counterfeit and Marketplace Monitoring](https://www.markmonitor.com/solutions/counterfeit-and-marketplace-monitoring/): Monitoring and enforcement across marketplaces for counterfeit and unauthorized goods.
- [Domain Security](https://www.markmonitor.com/solutions/domain-security/): Protection for critical domains, DNS, and related digital infrastructure.
- [Digital Risk Protection](https://www.markmonitor.com/solutions/digital-risk-protection/): Broader protection against external threats targeting brands, customers, and executives.

## Industries
- [Financial Services](https://www.markmonitor.com/industries/financial-services/): Brand and fraud protection tailored to banks, payments, and financial institutions.
- [Healthcare and Pharmaceuticals](https://www.markmonitor.com/industries/healthcare-and-pharmaceuticals/): Protection for regulated brands facing fraud, abuse, and counterfeit risks.
- [Retail and Ecommerce](https://www.markmonitor.com/industries/retail-and-ecommerce/): Support for consumer brands combating counterfeits, impersonation, and marketplace abuse.
- [Technology](https://www.markmonitor.com/industries/technology/): Domain and brand protection for global technology companies and platforms.
- [Media and Entertainment](https://www.markmonitor.com/industries/media-and-entertainment/): Protection against piracy, impersonation, and abuse affecting media brands.
- [Travel and Hospitality](https://www.markmonitor.com/industries/travel-and-hospitality/): Solutions for travel brands facing phishing, fraud, and customer trust issues.
